title: Woods's partner frozen at the wheel
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I even tried pulling his hand off that steering wheel.

plain: In 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a man named Michael Johnson froze stiff at the wheel of a vehicle, so locked up that his partner could not pry his hand loose, according to that partner, Mario Woods. Woods says he was there and even tried pulling Johnson's hand off the steering wheel. He tells it as part of a strange encounter at the base that seemed to paralyse a man in place.
